emulator_workaround: Instance-local fixed-Thumb setISAMode callback replacement matching the existing status/timeout verifier. Rejects ARM transitions; original instruction p-code and firmware bytes unchanged. Initial run without this workaround failed at the first logger BL and does not count as a completed verification.
scope: Original limit pack/cache control flow across all 16x16 nibble combinations and selected prior cache bytes; synthetic successful/failed write returns and matching/mismatched readback returns. Separate original retry-loop fixtures succeed on attempt 1/2/3 or exhaust all three. Original protocol-cache fixtures cover both ports, all UFCS/SCP combinations and four prior bytes: changed requests receive a synthetic exhausted-write failure, then an identical invocation must return success without writing. Cases already matching the desired cache skip both writes. Calls execute the original BL; external logger/delay/I2C entry points are stubbed by returning to actual LR without modifying original bytes. Stops before POP PC. Synthetic SRAM only; physical bus, controller firmware, negotiation, electrical limits, protection replay and actual faults excluded. Stub return values are test inputs, not observed hardware failures.
